TYPHOID.gloss: serious infection marked by intestinal inflammation and ulceration
TYPHOID.definition: Serious infection marked by intestinal inflammation and ulceration; caused by Salmonella typhosa ingested with food or water.

HYOID.gloss: a U-shaped bone at the base of the tongue that supports the tongue muscles
HYOID.definition: A U-shaped bone at the base of the tongue that supports the tongue muscles.

DHOTI.gloss: a long loincloth worn by Hindu men
DHOTI.definition: A long loincloth worn by Hindu men.

PITY.gloss: a feeling of sympathy and sorrow for the misfortunes of others
PITY.definition: A feeling of sympathy and sorrow for the misfortunes of others.
PITY.example: The blind are too often objects of pity.

TIDY.gloss: receptacle that holds odds and ends
TIDY.definition: Receptacle that holds odds and ends (as sewing materials).

TYPO.gloss: a mistake in printed matter resulting from mechanical failures of some kind
TYPO.definition: A mistake in printed matter resulting from mechanical failures of some kind.

TOP.example: The mower cuts off the tops of the grass.

HOT.definition: Used of physical heat; having a high or higher than desirable temperature or giving off heat or feeling or causing a sensation of heat or burning.

TIP.definition: The extreme end of something; especially something pointed.

HIP.gloss: either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh
HIP.definition: Either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

POT.gloss: metal or earthenware cooking vessel that is usually round and deep
POT.definition: Metal or earthenware cooking vessel that is usually round and deep; often has a handle and lid.

TOY.gloss: an artifact designed to be played with
TOY.definition: An artifact designed to be played with.

PIT.definition: A sizeable hole (usually in the ground).
PIT.example: They dug a pit to bury the body.

DIP.gloss: immerse briefly into a liquid so as to wet, coat, or saturate
DIP.definition: Immerse briefly into a liquid so as to wet, coat, or saturate.
DIP.example: Dip the garment into the cleaning solution.
